capabilities.name: search
capabilities.description: Search for patterns in files. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: transform
capabilities.description: Transform text with pattern-based substitution. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: analyze
capabilities.description: Analyze text with field-based processing and aggregation. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: pipeline
capabilities.description: Execute multi-stage processing pipelines. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: ontology
capabilities.description: Output the complete ATP ontology for agent discovery. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: explain
capabilities.description: Explain what a command will do before execution. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: scope
capabilities.description: List files matching the current scope configuration. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: query
capabilities.description: Execute AQL (ATP Query Language) queries -- unified syntax for agents and humans. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: validate
capabilities.description: Validate a pattern, expression, pipeline, or AQL query without executing. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: context
capabilities.description: Extract smart context windows around a specific line. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: compliance
capabilities.description: Compliance reporting -- NIST FIPS, CMMC 2.0, DoD regulatory posture. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: atp-grep
capabilities.description: POSIX grep-compatible binary with typed structured output. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: atp-sed
capabilities.description: POSIX sed-compatible binary with typed structured output. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: atp-awk
capabilities.description: POSIX awk-compatible binary with typed structured output. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: repl
capabilities.description: Interactive AQL shell with history. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: watch
capabilities.description: Re-run an AQL query whenever the watched files change. Runs until stopped. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: completions
capabilities.description: Print shell completion scripts to stdout. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: manpage
capabilities.description: Print a man page to stdout, or write all man pages to a directory. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: config
capabilities.description: View and manage ATP configuration. Changes here alter the defaults every later command runs under. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: mcp
capabilities.description: Serve the ATP tool surface over JSON-RPC for agents. Runs until stopped, and re-exposes search, transform, query and analyze to whatever connects. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: ai
capabilities.description: Natural language to AQL, explanation and suggestion via an LLM. Not deterministic, and sends the prompt to whichever model is configured. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: remote
capabilities.description: Run ATP commands on remote hosts over SSH. Declared as modifying because what it runs remotely may be transform. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: symbols
capabilities.description: Extract and search symbols in source code. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: plugin
capabilities.description: Install, remove, scaffold and validate ATP plugins. Installing puts new code where ATP will load it. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: index
capabilities.description: Build, search and manage the file index. Building writes the index to disk. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=true.

capabilities.name: debug
capabilities.description: Step through an AQL pipeline, inspecting each stage. Declares: modifies_files=false, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: notebook
capabilities.description: Execute a literate AQL notebook (Markdown plus AQL). Declared as modifying because a notebook may contain transform stages. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=false.

capabilities.name: distributed
capabilities.description: Scatter/gather pipeline execution across workers. Declared as modifying because the pipeline it runs may contain transform stages. Declares: modifies_files=true, deterministic=false.

note: requires_grant is DERIVED from modifies_files, which ATP declares per command alongside deterministic, supports_dry_run and supports_explain. An earlier version of this file said ATP declared no effect data; that was wrong -- it declared effects for the eleven commands it covered, and I had searched for the wrong field names. The real gap was coverage: eleven of twenty-five subcommands. The fourteen missing included plugin, which installs code where ATP will load it; config, which changes the defaults every later command runs under; remote, which runs ATP over SSH; and mcp, which re-exposes the whole surface over JSON-RPC. A drift test now walks clap's parsed Command, and it found nine of those fourteen after a first pass that had already tried to close the gap -- including one entry named `man` when the command is `manpage`, which would have read as complete and matched nothing. Four commands are declared modifying for a second-order reason, and the descriptions say so: remote, notebook, distributed and mcp do not themselves rewrite files, but each executes pipelines that may contain transform. Declaring them read-only would be true of the command and false of its consequences. The three compatibility shims -- atp-grep, atp-sed, atp-awk -- appear in the ontology but not in the subcommand list, because they are separate binaries. That asymmetry is deliberate and the drift test only checks one direction for that reason. Budgets are judged and mark the commands whose cost scales with the file set scanned or that run until stopped.
